findings.finding: SelfAlternativeCost has manaCost, additionalCosts and a game-state condition. PlayerCastSpellsThisTurn uses captured cast records, and CastSpellHandler appends records when casting. This supplies candidate own-prior-spell eligibility semantics without relying on a spell remaining on the stack.
findings.limit: No execution or surge qualification inferred. Teammate eligibility is not expressed by a named Player reference in the complete reviewed sealed Player.kt.

findings.finding: The selected AlternativeCostType is transported onto SpellOnStackComponent. The generic SELF_ALTERNATIVE choice is not itself a durable paid-surge condition.

The durable CastChoices bag stamps declared additional costs and named sneak/web-slinging/mayhem/waterbend/gift flags. The complete reviewed ChoiceSlot enum has no SELF_ALTERNATIVE or SURGE slot, and this entry-transfer block does not stamp the generic chosen alternative. A faithful paid-surge ETB requires an explicitly proposed protected-boundary extension; existing Disciple/Opal/Fblthp grants do not authorize it.

CastTimeFlagSet captures whether a game-state condition held, not which alternative was paid. Eligibility, amount of mana spent, or current spell count must not substitute for actual surge payment: normal-price casts on the same eligible board must produce no surge payoff.

required_future_controls: Eligible own earlier spell resolved/countered/still on stack; opponent-only prior spell must not qualify.
Normal-price cast on an eligible board versus actual alternative-price cast; discounts/taxes must not infer paid choice.
Serialized stack and entering permanent preserve the exact actual choice; copied/direct/blinked objects do not acquire it from eligibility alone.
Other creatures get the bounded pump/haste until end of turn; source exclusion and correct controller remain exact.
Explicitly scope teammate support and multiplayer admission; preserve every existing choice slot and all target/source behavior.
Compile normal and every declared mutant before behavior, then full same-source compatibility/card/snapshot/lint/metadata/printing/Assay/original receiving.
